description: Main server setup script for a Node.js backend, configuring server parameters, environment validation, database readiness checks, and server startup with graceful shutdown.

methods.name: logStartupSummary
methods.description: Logs current runtime configuration and environment variables for diagnostics.

methods.name: ensureJwtSecret
methods.description: Ensures JWT secret exists; auto-generates in development, exits if missing in production.

methods.name: checkMysqlEnv
methods.description: Checks for presence of MySQL environment variables and warns if incomplete.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Main async function that initializes configuration, checks database readiness, sets up middleware, and starts the HTTP server.
